answer: Sybil farms mint free keys to flood attest slots. Each worker parks a 96-hour locked bond at the loading wharf for one berth ledge. An admission kernel stores H(pubkey||lot_id||bond_txid) and allows one live ledge per 4-hop funding cluster; a second booking sharing a co-signer or refund address is refused. Cost is 60 locked units plus 25 minutes dwell before first attest. Peers recompute the cluster cut and check bond age and kernel preimage on the lot map. If the bond unlocks early or two ledges later merge, the lot is slashed and pending atts from that ledge are voided for twelve epochs.
